name: Minamoto Saku
source:
Element: Hydrogen
Rank: 純弐位
Hobby/Skill: Going to sweets place/Star gazing

Saku comes from the Minamoto family—a family that is famous for producing Hydrogen Shikenkan officers. Serious and calm, but weak to unexpected happenings. Also, unable to take a joke. 
He is proud to be a Shikenkan and will go all out to fulfill his missions.
